method.label: Weight classes by who is chosen

annotationRationale: The student average weights each class size by the proportion of students in classes of that size. The teacher average uses the ordinary arithmetic mean.
sourceMethod: Follows the official weighted-average calculation, grouping the students by class size and explicitly calculating their selection probabilities.

review.mathCheck: Teacher sampling gives \(t=100/5=20\). Student sampling gives \(s=(50^2+2\cdot20^2+2\cdot5^2)/100=33.5\), including each selected student. Thus \(t-s=-13.5\), choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA AMC 10A solution 10 on page 4, using equal teacher weights and student proportions 50/100, 40/100 and 10/100.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation explicitly constructs the weights and distinguishes the two sampling schemes; no probability formalism is needed.
